request: Analyze GSE293221 for the paper (Exercise and Phellodendron amurense extract differentially impinge on oxidative stress response pathways in a mouse model of prostate cancer): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (KAPA stranded RiboErase, HiSeq 3000 50bp SE), prostate tumor tissue of male TRAMP mice (S4.6.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: 18 male TRAMP mice randomized 1:1:1 to control, exercise (voluntary wheel running, singly housed), Phellodendron amurense extract diet (S4.2.p1); 12-week intervention; tumors from 3 representative animals per group sequenced (S2.2.p1, S4.6.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 12 weeks of voluntary wheel running vs no intervention on prostate tumor gene expression in TRAMP mice (S2.2.p1)
planned_contrasts: Phellodendron amurense extract vs control (S2.2.p2; paper: 176 DEGs, 100 down / 76 up)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; one tumor per animal, independent animals
final.normalization: DESeq size-factor normalization of HTSeq counts (S4.7.p1)
final.paper_method: R package DESeq (original), group-pairwise comparisons on HTSeq counts; TopHat to UCSC genome (S4.7.p1)

paper_threshold.extra_filter: at least one group average RPKM > 1

paper_results.exercise_vs_control: 32 DEGs; down: Lipe, Plin1, Slc7a10, Gpr83; up: Dgat2l6 (S2.2.p1, S3.p1)
paper_results.pham_vs_control: 176 DEGs (100 down, 76 up); down Spink3, Spink5, Slc26a4, Slc45a3, Slc5a8, Apof, Pls1, Mmp7, Dclk3, Gstt3, Atp2c2; up Dcx, Sncb (S2.2.p2, S3.p2)
paper_results.overlap: BB123696 and Lman1l up in both (S2.2.p3)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.2.p1 and S4.6.p1: 3 tumors per group sequenced; S4.7.p1 gives method (DESeq, group-pairwise) and the three-part DEG rule (RPKM>1 in one group, FDR<0.05, FC>1.5 either way). Exercise vs control is the request's estimand; PhAm vs control is the paper's second planned contrast.

checks: GEO metadata: TRAMP C57BL/6 prostate tumor tissue, treatment column matches control/running wheel/Phellodendron extract arms of S4.2.p1
9 samples = 3 per group as in S4.6.p1; HTSeq-count + TopHat mm9 in data_processing matches S4.7.p1

ownership.reasoning: Accession, organism, tissue, arms, n and processing all match the paper.

alignment.reasoning: prep_matrix.py renames the merged HTSeq tar columns to their GSM ids (exact equal to the metadata index) and fixes row order (values unchanged); group from title (Control/Exercise/Nexrutine, rep1-3), consistent with the characteristics treatment column.

final.source: per-sample HTSeq-count files in GSE293221_RAW.tar merged by gene symbol (GSE293221_merged_from_tar.csv), columns renamed to GSM ids and rows reordered by prep_matrix.py

matrix.reasoning: Integer fraction 1.0, median 61, max ~1e6, library sums 7.5-14M; data_processing states HTSeq-count read counts. Matches the paper's stated input.

final.analysis_type: multi-group, one model, pairwise contrasts against control

candidates.reason_rejected: paper's DESeq was run on all groups with group-pairwise tests; one model on all 9 samples shares dispersion as the original DESeq did
different interventions; paper contrasts each with control

design.reasoning: Three independent arms with one control (S4.2.p1); paper reports each intervention vs control (S2.2.p1, S2.2.p2). One model with planned contrasts; any other listed comparison is exploratory.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, one tumor each; no batch, lane or pairing recorded in GEO or paper. Housing (single for EX, group for CON/PHAM, S4.2.p1/S4.3.p1) is part of the intervention and fully aliased with arm, so it cannot and should not be modelled.

final.method: DESeq2 (pydeseq2 Wald), one model ~ grp, contrasts vs CON

paper_route.method: DESeq (original Bioconductor DESeq, negative-binomial exact test, group-pairwise)
paper_route.reason: no original-DESeq executor in this repository; DESeq2 is the validated successor on the same count input

deviations: DESeq2 Wald test instead of original DESeq exact test

paper's 'average RPKM > 1 in at least one group' filter not applied: no gene lengths in the deposit (gene-symbol HTSeq counts, mm9); DESeq2 independent filtering used instead; a CPM>=1 in >=3 samples low-count filter is run as a sensitivity analysis

method.reasoning: Raw integer counts support the negative-binomial route; reproduce the paper's NB count model with DESeq2 as a declared deviation.

final.deviation_note: Paper rule FDR<0.05 and FC>1.5 either way (|log2FC|>log2(1.5)=0.5849625) applied on DESeq2; the RPKM>1 expression prefilter cannot be applied (no gene lengths).

threshold.reasoning: S4.7.p1: FDR adjusted p < 0.05 and fold change > 1.5 (either way); ABS.p1 says >= 1.5-fold, S4.7.p1 (methods) says > 1.5, methods wording used.

caveats: n = 3 tumors per arm, chosen as 'representative' by the authors (S2.2.p1); small study
exercise arm singly housed while control group housed: housing is aliased with exercise
original DESeq and RPKM>1 prefilter not reproduced; DEG counts are expected to differ

Direction contradiction: paper says BB123696 and Lman1l increased with exercise and with PhAm (S2.2.p3); here both are lower in EX (log2FC -1.58, -1.83, not significant) and significantly lower in PHAM (log2FC -4.32, -5.33).

Paper exercise DEGs Lipe, Plin1, Slc7a10 agree in direction (down in EX, log2FC -1.5 to -2.4) but get padj NA in the joint model (Cook outlier flag driven by the heterogeneous PHAM arm); Dgat2l6 up (log2FC 5.8) but not significant.

Two of three PHAM tumors (GSM8878842, GSM8878843) are transcriptionally distinct from all other samples (Spearman ~0.6-0.7 vs >=0.93), with high Dcx/Sncb and loss of Spink3/Plin1 -- consistent with a different tumor phenotype; PHAM vs CON gives thousands of DEGs instead of the paper 176.

Exercise DEG set overlaps the paper only in count (32 vs 32); most of our EX DEGs are up (27/32) and include seminal-vesicle secretory genes (Svs1-6, Sva, Spinkl), suggesting differing seminal-vesicle tissue content in the excised tumors.

study.reasoning: Counts from S2.2.p1 / S2.2.p2; genes from S2.2.p1-p3, S3.p1, S3.p2. Expected directions: EX down Lipe, Plin1, Slc7a10, Gpr83; EX up Dgat2l6, BB123696, Lman1l; PHAM down Spink3..Atp2c2, up Dcx, Sncb, BB123696, Lman1l.

discrepancies.paper: 6 per arm randomized, 1 exercise mouse died (S2.1.p1); 3 per arm sequenced (S4.6.p1)

discrepancies.data: GEO extract protocol: Illumina stranded mRNA, molecule polyA RNA
raw HTSeq counts; only DESeq2 available

executions.name: joint_cpmfilter
executions.reasoning: Stand-in for the paper's RPKM>1 expression prefilter: keep genes with CPM>=1 in >=3 samples (one group's worth).

executions.reasoning: Two-arm DESeq2 on the 6 CON+EX samples only, so dispersion and Cook flags are not driven by the heterogeneous PHAM arm; paper says group-pairwise without stating whether dispersion was pooled across all groups.

enrichment.reasoning: Paper reports GO BP/MF and gene set enrichment for exercise DEGs (S2.2.p1, Fig. 3C,D)
